svg.text: Housing decrees: published, not yet validated
29 Sep — Council of Ministers approves two royal decree-laws
1 Oct — second decree published in the BOE (La Moncloa)
Congress must validate within 30 days or the text falls
Friday vote reported as the political deadline, not a court date
Timeline from La Moncloa note of 1 Oct 2026. Party votes were still moving that morning.
